aboutPage.meta.description: HatchGrab builds practical software for food truck and catering operators: online ordering, collection times, and less time answering the same questions over and over. Founded by Dominic Bonini.
aboutPage.meta.title: About us — HatchGrab
aboutPage.story.build: We build practical software specifically for food truck and catering operators, helping them take online orders, manage collection times, keep orders running smoothly and spend less time answering repetitive questions.
aboutPage.story.change: HatchGrab was born to change that.
aboutPage.story.fixedAddress: Yet most of the software they can use is designed for businesses with a fixed address.
aboutPage.story.focus: Our goal is simple: make running a food truck easier, with tools designed around how these businesses really operate.
aboutPage.story.start: HatchGrab grew out of a simple observation: food trucks need better tools to run their business.
aboutPage.story.villageFoodie: After founding Village Foodie (an information platform that helps people find food trucks coming to their neighbourhood), I spent more time understanding the challenges mobile food businesses face. Unlike traditional restaurants, food trucks are always on the move, trading at different locations and serving customers in constantly changing conditions.

comparison.explained.title: Feature explanations
comparison.faq.capacityA: Customers only see pickup times your kitchen can actually make. The system calculates from each dish’s preparation time and how many portions you can prepare at once.
comparison.faq.capacityQ: How does the system stop my kitchen being swamped with orders?
comparison.faq.costA: {plans}. Online card payments also carry Stripe fees: {cardFee} per card payment.
comparison.faq.costQ: How much does HatchGrab cost in {country}?
comparison.faq.costTrial: {months, plural, one {The first month is} other {The first # months are}} free, with every feature available.
comparison.faq.locationsA: Yes. You set the places and times of your weekly schedule, and customers can order for the place and day you are there.
comparison.faq.locationsQ: Can it be used if trading locations change often?
comparison.faq.paymentsA: Customers can pay online by credit card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay at the truck. PayPal and Klarna are not supported at the moment.
comparison.faq.paymentsQ: Which payment methods does HatchGrab support?
comparison.faq.termA: No. There is no minimum contract term and no advance notice needed. You can cancel any time; the fee is charged monthly in advance, and you can use it until the end of the month you have paid for.
comparison.faq.termQ: Is there a minimum contract term?
comparison.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
comparison.faq.tseA: HatchGrab is not a POS system and has no TSE. How to record online orders in your POS system, please ask your tax adviser.
comparison.faq.tseQ: Do I still need a POS system with a TSE?
comparison.faq.whatA: An ordering system lets customers order online before they reach the truck: they choose dishes and a pickup time, pay online or on pickup, and the order appears in your kitchen. A POS system or card reader takes payment at the truck. The two complement each other.
comparison.faq.whatQ: What is a food truck ordering system?

featuresPage.detail.accountant_reports: Sales, tax and refunds for any month, quarter or financial year, ready to download and hand to your accountant.
featuresPage.detail.advance_preordering: Let customers pre-order for a future date or time before the event.
featuresPage.detail.auto_accept: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm them one by one.
featuresPage.detail.branded_qr_code: Add your brand logo to your QR code.
featuresPage.detail.buzzer_tracking: When you hand out a buzzer, record its number on the order, so you know which buzzer goes with which order.
featuresPage.detail.customer_display: A screen customers can see, showing order numbers and when they can collect.
featuresPage.detail.discovery_map_listin: Your truck appears on the public HatchGrab map, so nearby customers can find you.
featuresPage.detail.documents_reminders: Keep your certificates in one place, such as food hygiene, insurance and gas safety. We remind you before any document expires, and you can send them to an event or market organiser in one tap.
featuresPage.detail.embed_schedule: Show your upcoming trading dates on your own website; each one links straight to its ordering page.
featuresPage.detail.event_types: Create your own event types, with their own prices and settings for events and festivals.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_app: The most complete way to use HatchGrab: a live kitchen display system (KDS), and the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.
featuresPage.detail.kitchen_capacity: Set how many portions the kitchen can make at once and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers can no longer choose it.
featuresPage.detail.loyalty_stamp_cards: Reward returning customers with digital stamp cards — collecting and redeeming happen automatically.
featuresPage.detail.meal_deals_upsells: Combine items into deals and suggest add-ons at checkout to raise the average order value.
featuresPage.detail.messenger_instagram_: Same as WhatsApp auto-replies, but for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.
featuresPage.detail.multi_device_kitchen: Use several screens at once — the front counter and the kitchen — all showing the same live orders.
featuresPage.detail.multi_user_access: Create separate login accounts for staff, with the appropriate permissions.
featuresPage.detail.offline_protection: As soon as you lose signal, online ordering pauses, so customers won’t place orders you can’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app lets you keep taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs an internet connection.
featuresPage.detail.online_payments: When customers order online, take card payment in advance via Stripe.
featuresPage.detail.preorder_deadline: Set a pre-order cut-off time for items that need advance preparation.
featuresPage.detail.private_events: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.
featuresPage.detail.profit_per_event: Enter the cost of each dish and see how much you actually made at every event, not just your turnover.
featuresPage.detail.qr_code: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page when scanned.
featuresPage.detail.schedule_import: We fill in your schedule for you automatically — from your website, or a photo you’ve already posted on Facebook. You just check and confirm.
featuresPage.detail.sms_order_alerts: Automatically text customers when their order is ready.
featuresPage.detail.social_media_posts: Upload your designs — we automatically fill in the dates, places and times for each week and each event.
featuresPage.detail.sold_out_toggle: Mark any item as sold out in one tap — it turns grey for customers straight away.
featuresPage.detail.stock_countdown: Set a stock quantity; it counts down automatically as orders come in, and is marked sold out automatically when gone.
featuresPage.detail.tap_to_pay: Take card payments on a supported phone, with no need for a separate card reader.
featuresPage.detail.ticket_printing: Print order tickets on a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.
featuresPage.detail.time_slot_selection: Customers choose their own collection time, spreading orders across your whole service period.
featuresPage.detail.walkup_orders: Take and manage orders right at the truck, taking payment on your own card reader.
featuresPage.detail.web_dashboard: Run your service from the browser on any phone, tablet or laptop.
featuresPage.detail.whatsapp_auto_replie: Answer enquiries about your menu and schedule with WhatsApp auto-replies.

landing.does.capacityBody: Set how many portions you can make at once and how long it takes. Once a collection time is full, customers can no longer choose it.
landing.does.devicesBody: Works on the phone in your apron pocket, the tablet on the counter, the laptop in the truck — and with the card reader you already use to take payment.
landing.does.lede: Most ordering systems assume you have a fixed address, stable Wi-Fi and the same opening hours every week. But you set up somewhere different every week, at irregular times, with patchy mobile signal or none at all. HatchGrab was born for exactly that.
landing.does.offlineBody: As soon as you lose signal, online ordering pauses automatically, so customers won’t place orders you can’t see. Keep taking orders with the iPhone, iPad and Android app.
landing.does.offlineTitle: No signal? Keep serving all the same.
landing.does.postsBody: Upload the image design you usually post on Facebook or Instagram; we fill in the dates, places and times automatically, ready to share every week or every day.
landing.does.slotsBody: Customers pre-order online and choose a collection time. Shorter queues, and the food is ready as soon as the customer arrives.
landing.does.slotsTitle: Customers choose their own collection time
landing.does.title: Designed for food trucks, not for restaurants.
landing.does.whatsappBody: “Where are you set up tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Whether you’re driving to your pitch or busy at the grill, WhatsApp replies automatically using your menu and schedule. Messenger and Instagram coming soon.
landing.does.whatsappSoonBody: “Where are you set up tonight?” “What desserts do you have?” Soon, even while you’re driving to your pitch or busy at the grill, WhatsApp will reply automatically. Messenger and Instagram will follow.
